name: orderflow-operations
description: Production-like commercial operations MVP for order, inventory, and ERP synchronization management

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,erp -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:erp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orderflow/contracts && npm run build -w @orderflow/api && npm run build -w @orderflow/erp-mock && npm run build -w @orderflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orderflow/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @orderflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @orderflow/erp-mock && npm run typecheck -w @orderflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
